items.statement: Determine whether the proposed explanation survives the expanded comparisons: Judge whether added electronic information survives honest out-of-fold and assay-resolution controls, with n=10 limitations. Support, refutation and evidence-sufficient indistinguishability are scored equally for scientific reasoning. No expected winner or old scalar agreement is a completion criterion.
